name: qfd_tt_up4_tp8-rt1-COMMIT
purpose: qwen-tp8 (results/arch/qwen_tp8_1012): tree-top UPPER sub-tile ot_qfd_band_upper at TP8 = NB 3 bands (GT 3,072), LG 12, NL 4; parameter setting of the TP4 qfd_tt_up4_b element (NB 6, LG 13, 345.6 x 388.8), same faces (band words W, returns E, select S); outline resized to the TP8 content (std 5,942 um2 synthesized; W/E faces ~390 pins each over M4/M6 at ~1 b/um/layer set the 205 um height)

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN --top-module ot_qfd_band_upper rtl/qwen_sys/lane_band_20261008/ot_qfd_band_lanes.sv rtl/qwen_sys/missing_masters_20261007/ot_qfd_spine_masters.sv rtl/hdc/ot_qwen_me_spine_h_w12.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_delay.sv rtl/hdc/ot_qwen_w12_arith.sv rtl/hdc/ot_qwen_w12_matvec.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fastfp.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_add_lat.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_mul_lat.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_prefix.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fpu.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_fp32_mul_pipe.sv rtl/proto/ot_fp32_add_rne_pipe.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_sfu.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.01 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qfd_tt_up4_tp8/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qfd_tt_up4_tp8/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qfd_tt_up4_tp8 --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_qfd_band_upper  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run
